correctness.rationale: For odd n, quandle identity implies every map is affine; composition gives exact determinant relation. For p^e primitive neighborhoods are cyclic lines and hence simplicial. The remaining graph is the p²-clique blowup modulo p^(e-2); induction gives PEO. Primitive-line/core disjoint count proves full clique polynomial. CRT pair of orthogonal idempotents produces chordless 4-cycle if n has two distinct primes. Exact code verified direct small cases; unproved even moduli excluded.
